enchantments.tooltip: Strength +6: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Exceptional Charisma +1: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +1 Exceptional bonus to Charisma.
Hunter of the Dead: 3 extra uses of Remove Disease per rest. If have Hunter of the Dead III Enhancement: additional weapon damage versus Undead.

Incredible Potential: Incredible Potential: This ring's power has not been fully unleashed. When this ring is combined with 9 Shavarath War Trophies and ac Imbued Shard of Great Power in an Altar of Subjugation, its full potential will be reveled.
